title_en: Administrative Reconsideration Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is enacted in accordance with the Constitution for the purposes of preventing and correcting illegal or improper administrative acts, protecting the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons and other organizations, supervising and ensuring that administrative organs exercise their powers according to law, giving full play to the principal role of administrative reconsideration in resolving administrative disputes, and promoting the building of a law-based government.

Article 2 This Law shall apply to cases where any citizen, legal person or other organization, deeming that an administrative act of an administrative organ has infringed upon his or her or its lawful rights and interests, files an application for administrative reconsideration with an administrative reconsideration organ, and the administrative reconsideration organ handles the case of administrative reconsideration.
The term "administrative act" as mentioned in the preceding paragraph includes the administrative act of any organization authorized by laws, regulations or rules.

Article 3 The work of administrative reconsideration shall adhere to the leadership of the Communist Party of China.
An administrative reconsideration organ, when performing its administrative reconsideration duties, shall follow the principles of legality, impartiality, openness, efficiency, convenience for the people, and serving the people, persist in correcting any errors, and ensure the correct implementation of laws and regulations.

Article 4 The people's governments at or above the county level and other administrative organs that perform the duties of administrative reconsideration in accordance with this Law are the administrative reconsideration organs.
The institution that handles the matters of administrative reconsideration for an administrative reconsideration organ is the administrative reconsideration institution. The administrative reconsideration institution shall at the same time organize the handling of the administrative litigation response matters of the administrative reconsideration organ.
An administrative reconsideration organ shall strengthen its administrative reconsideration work, support and ensure that the administrative reconsideration institution performs its duties according to law. The administrative reconsideration institution at a higher level shall guide and supervise the administrative reconsideration work of the administrative reconsideration institution at a lower level.
The administrative reconsideration institution of the State Council may publish guiding cases for administrative reconsideration.

Article 5 An administrative reconsideration organ may conduct mediation when handling a case of administrative reconsideration.
Mediation shall follow the principles of legality and voluntariness, shall not harm the national interest, public interest or the lawful rights and interests of others, and shall not violate the mandatory provisions of laws or regulations.

Article 6 The State shall establish a contingent of specialized and professional administrative reconsideration personnel.
Persons who initially engage in administrative reconsideration work in an administrative reconsideration institution shall pass the national unified legal professional qualification examination to obtain legal professional qualifications, and shall participate in unified pre-service training.
The administrative reconsideration institution of the State Council shall, in conjunction with the relevant departments, formulate work norms for administrative reconsideration personnel, and strengthen the professional assessment and management of administrative reconsideration personnel.

Article 7 An administrative reconsideration organ shall ensure that the staffing of the administrative reconsideration institution is commensurate with the work tasks it undertakes, improve the professional competence of administrative reconsideration personnel, and guarantee, based on work needs, venues, equipment and other facilities for handling cases. The people's governments at or above the county level shall include the working funds for administrative reconsideration in their respective budgets.

Article 8 An administrative reconsideration organ shall strengthen information technology development, apply modern information technology to facilitate citizens, legal persons or other organizations to apply for and participate in administrative reconsideration, and improve work quality and efficiency.

Article 9 Units and individuals that have made remarkable achievements in the administrative reconsideration work shall be commended and rewarded in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State.

Article 10 Where any citizen, legal person or other organization disagrees with an administrative reconsideration decision, it may, in accordance with the provisions of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, bring an administrative action before a people's court, except where the law provides that the administrative reconsideration decision is final.

Article 14: A citizen, legal person, or other organization applying for administrative reconsideration in accordance with this Law shall be the applicant.
Where a citizen who has the right to apply for administrative reconsideration dies, his close relatives may apply for administrative reconsideration. Where a legal person or other organization that has the right to apply for administrative reconsideration terminates, the successor of its rights and obligations may apply for administrative reconsideration.
Where a citizen who has the right to apply for administrative reconsideration is a person without civil capacity or with limited civil capacity, his legal representative may apply for administrative reconsideration on his behalf.

Article 15: Where there is a large number of applicants in the same administrative reconsideration case, the applicants may elect a representative to participate in the administrative reconsideration.
The acts of the representative in participating in the administrative reconsideration shall have effect on the applicants represented by him; however, where the representative modifies the administrative reconsideration request, withdraws the administrative reconsideration application, or admits the request of a third party, it shall be subject to the consent of the represented applicants.

Article 16: A citizen, legal person, or other organization other than the applicant that has an interest in the administrative act subject to administrative reconsideration or the outcome of the administrative reconsideration case may apply to participate in the administrative reconsideration as a third party, or may be notified by the administrative reconsideration agency to participate in the administrative reconsideration as a third party.
The non-participation of a third party in the administrative reconsideration shall not affect the trial of the administrative reconsideration case.

Article 17: The applicant or a third party may entrust one to two lawyers, grassroots legal service workers, or other agents to participate in the administrative reconsideration on their behalf.
Where the applicant or a third party entrusts an agent, it shall submit to the administrative reconsideration agency a power of attorney and identity documents of the principal and the entrusted person. The power of attorney shall specify the matters entrusted, the authority, and the term. Where the applicant or a third party modifies or revokes the authority of the agent, it shall notify the administrative reconsideration agency in writing.
Article 18: Where an applicant for administrative reconsideration who meets the conditions for legal aid applies for legal aid, the legal aid agency shall provide him with legal aid according to law.

Article 19: Where a citizen, legal person, or other organization applies for administrative reconsideration because it is dissatisfied with an administrative act, the administrative organ or the organization authorized by laws, regulations, or rules that made the administrative act shall be the respondent.
Where two or more administrative organs make the same administrative act in a joint name, the administrative organs that jointly made the administrative act shall be the respondent.
Where an organization entrusted by an administrative organ makes an administrative act, the entrusting administrative organ shall be the respondent.
Where the administrative organ that made the administrative act is abolished or its functions are changed, the administrative organ that continues to exercise its functions shall be the respondent.

Article 20: Where a citizen, legal person, or other organization considers that an administrative act has infringed upon its lawful rights and interests, it may file an application for administrative reconsideration within 60 days from the date on which it knows or should have known the administrative act; except where the statutory time limit for application exceeds 60 days.
Where the statutory time limit for application is delayed due to force majeure or other legitimate reasons, the time limit for application shall continue to be counted from the date on which the obstacle is removed.
Where an administrative organ, when making an administrative act, fails to inform the citizen, legal person, or other organization of the right to apply for administrative reconsideration, the administrative reconsideration organ, and the time limit for application, the time limit for application shall be counted from the date on which the citizen, legal person, or other organization knows or should have known the right to apply for administrative reconsideration, the administrative reconsideration organ, and the time limit for application; however, it shall not exceed one year from the date on which it knows or should have known the content of the administrative act.

Article 21: Where an application for administrative reconsideration concerning immovable property is filed more than 20 years after the date on which the administrative act was made, or other applications for administrative reconsideration are filed more than five years after such date, the administrative reconsideration organ shall not accept it.

Article 22: An applicant applying for administrative reconsideration may apply in writing; where it is difficult to apply in writing, he may also apply orally.
Where applying in writing, the application for administrative reconsideration may be submitted by mail or through an internet channel designated by the administrative reconsideration organ, or may be submitted in person. Where an administrative organ serves a decision on an administrative act through an internet channel, it shall simultaneously provide an internet channel for submitting the application for administrative reconsideration.
Where applying orally, the administrative reconsideration organ shall record on the spot the basic information of the applicant, the administrative reconsideration request, the main facts, reasons, and time of the application for administrative reconsideration.
Where an applicant is dissatisfied with two or more administrative acts, he shall file separate applications for administrative reconsideration.

Article 26: Where a party is dissatisfied with an administrative reconsideration decision made by the people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 24 of this Law, or by a department of the State Council in accordance with the provisions of item (1) of Article 25 of this Law, it may file an administrative lawsuit with the People's Court; it may also apply to the State Council for an adjudication, and the State Council shall make a final adjudication in accordance with the provisions of this Law.

Article 27: Where a party is dissatisfied with an administrative act of an administrative organ with vertical leadership such as customs, finance, foreign exchange management, taxation, and state security organs, it shall apply for administrative reconsideration to the competent authority at the next higher level.

Article 28: Where a party is dissatisfied with an administrative act of the judicial administration department of a local people's government that performs the duties of an administrative reconsideration agency, it may apply for administrative reconsideration to the people's government at the same level, or to the judicial administration department at the next higher level.

Article 29: Where a citizen, legal person, or other organization applies for administrative reconsideration and the administrative reconsideration organ has accepted it according to law, it shall not file an administrative lawsuit with the People's Court during the period of administrative reconsideration.
Where a citizen, legal person, or other organization files an administrative lawsuit with the People's Court and the People's Court has accepted it according to law, it shall not apply for administrative reconsideration.

Article 31 If the materials for an application for administrative reconsideration are incomplete or the statements are unclear, making it impossible to determine whether the application complies with the provisions of Article 30, paragraph 1 of this Law, the administrative reconsideration authority shall, within five days from the date of receiving the application, notify the applicant in writing to make corrections. The correction notice shall specify in a one-time manner the matters that need correction.
The applicant shall submit the correction materials within ten days from the date of receiving the correction notice. If the applicant cannot make corrections within the time limit due to justified reasons, the administrative reconsideration authority may extend the correction period reasonably. If the applicant fails to make corrections within the time limit without justified reasons, the applicant shall be deemed to have withdrawn the application for administrative reconsideration, and this shall be recorded.
After receiving the correction materials, the administrative reconsideration authority shall handle the matter in accordance with the provisions of Article 30 of this Law.

Article 32 Where a party applies for administrative reconsideration due to dissatisfaction with an administrative penalty decision made on the spot or based on illegal facts recorded by electronic technical monitoring equipment, the party may submit the application for administrative reconsideration through the administrative organ that made the administrative penalty decision.
After receiving the application for administrative reconsideration, the administrative organ shall handle it promptly; if it considers that the administrative penalty decision shall be upheld, it shall transfer the application to the administrative reconsideration authority within five days from the date of receiving the application.

Article 33 If, after accepting an application for administrative reconsideration, the administrative reconsideration authority finds that the application does not comply with the provisions of Article 30, paragraph 1 of this Law, it shall decide to reject the application and state the reasons.

Article 34 Where, according to laws or administrative regulations, a party shall first apply to an administrative reconsideration authority for administrative reconsideration, and may file an administrative action with the People's Court only if dissatisfied with the reconsideration decision, if the administrative reconsideration authority decides not to accept the application, rejects the application, or after accepting the application fails to make a reply within the time limit for administrative reconsideration, the citizen, legal person, or other organization may, within fifteen days from the date of receiving the written decision or from the date of expiration of the time limit for administrative reconsideration, file an administrative action with the People's Court according to law.

Article 35 If a citizen, legal person, or other organization files an application for administrative reconsideration according to law, and the administrative reconsideration authority, without justified reasons, fails to accept the application, rejects the application, or after accepting it fails to make a reply within the time limit for administrative reconsideration, the applicant has the right to report to the higher-level administrative organ, and the higher-level administrative organ shall order it to correct the situation; if necessary, the higher-level administrative reconsideration authority may directly accept the application.

Article 36: After accepting an application for administrative reconsideration, the administrative reconsideration organ shall conduct the review in accordance with this Law by applying ordinary procedures or summary procedures. The administrative reconsideration agency shall designate administrative reconsideration personnel to be responsible for handling the administrative reconsideration case.
Administrative reconsideration personnel shall keep confidential state secrets, trade secrets, and personal privacy that they become aware of during the handling of the administrative reconsideration case.

Article 37. An administrative reconsideration authority shall hear administrative reconsideration cases in accordance with laws, regulations, and rules.
When hearing an administrative reconsideration case in an ethnic autonomous area, the administrative reconsideration authority shall also apply the autonomy regulations and separate regulations of that ethnic autonomous area.

Article 38. A higher-level administrative reconsideration authority may, as needed, hear an administrative reconsideration case within the jurisdiction of a lower-level administrative reconsideration authority.
If a lower-level administrative reconsideration authority considers that an administrative reconsideration case within its jurisdiction needs to be heard by a higher-level administrative reconsideration authority, it may submit a request to the higher-level administrative reconsideration authority for a decision.

Article 40. If an administrative reconsideration authority suspends administrative reconsideration without justifiable reason during the period of administrative reconsideration, the higher-level administrative organ shall order it to resume the hearing.

Article 45. An administrative reconsideration authority has the power to investigate and collect evidence from relevant entities and individuals, to consult, copy, and obtain relevant documents and materials, and to inquire of relevant persons.
When investigating and collecting evidence, the administrative reconsideration personnel shall be no fewer than two persons and shall present their administrative reconsideration work credentials.
The entities and individuals under investigation shall actively cooperate with the administrative reconsideration personnel and shall not refuse or obstruct.

Article 46. During the period of administrative reconsideration, the respondent shall not collect evidence from the applicant or other relevant entities or individuals on its own; evidence collected on its own shall not serve as the basis for determining the legality or appropriateness of the administrative act.
During the period of administrative reconsideration, if the applicant or a third party raises reasons or evidence that were not raised at the time the administrative act under reconsideration was performed, the respondent may supplement evidence with the consent of the administrative reconsideration organ.

Article 47. During the period of administrative reconsideration, the applicant, the third party, and their authorized agents may, in accordance with the provisions, consult and copy the written reply, evidence, basis, and other relevant materials submitted by the respondent, and the administrative reconsideration organ shall grant consent except where state secrets, trade secrets, personal privacy, or potential harm to national security, public security, or social stability are involved.

Article 48. The administrative reconsideration organ shall, within seven days from the date of acceptance of the application for administrative reconsideration, send a copy of the application for administrative reconsideration or a copy of the record of application for administrative reconsideration to the respondent. The respondent shall, within ten days from the date of receipt of the copy of the application or the copy of the record, submit a written reply and provide the evidence, basis, and other relevant materials concerning the performance of the administrative act.

Article 49. For an administrative reconsideration case subject to ordinary procedure, the administrative reconsideration organ shall hear the opinions of the parties in person or via the internet, telephone, or other means, and shall record the opinions heard in the case file. If the parties' opinions cannot be heard due to reasons attributable to the parties, a written trial may be conducted.

Article 50. For a major, difficult, or complex administrative reconsideration case, the administrative reconsideration organ shall hold a hearing.
If the administrative reconsideration organ considers a hearing necessary, or if the applicant requests a hearing, the administrative reconsideration organ may hold a hearing.
The hearing shall be presided over by one administrative reconsideration officer, with two or more administrative reconsideration officers serving as hearing panel members, and one recorder to prepare the hearing record.

Article 51. If the administrative reconsideration organ holds a hearing, it shall notify the parties in writing of the time, place, and matters to be heard at least five days before the hearing.
If the applicant, without justifiable reason, refuses to attend the hearing, the applicant shall be deemed to have waived the right to a hearing.
The responsible person of the respondent shall attend the hearing. If unable to attend, he or she shall state the reasons and delegate an appropriate staff member to attend the hearing.

Article 54. For an administrative reconsideration case subject to summary procedure, the administrative reconsideration organ shall send a copy of the application for administrative reconsideration or a copy of the record of application for administrative reconsideration to the respondent within three days from the date of acceptance of the application. The respondent shall, within five days from the date of receipt of the copy of the application or the copy of the record, submit a written reply and provide the evidence, basis, and other relevant materials concerning the performance of the administrative act.
For an administrative reconsideration case subject to summary procedure, a written trial may be conducted.

Article 55. For an administrative reconsideration case subject to summary procedure, if the administrative reconsideration organ considers that summary procedure is not appropriate, it may, with the approval of the head of the administrative reconsideration organ, transfer the case to ordinary procedure.

Article 56. If an applicant submits an application for incidental review of relevant regulatory documents pursuant to Article 13 of this Law, and the administrative reconsideration authority has the power to handle it, it shall handle it within thirty days according to law; if it does not have the power, it shall, within seven days, transfer the matter to the administrative organ with the power to handle it according to law.

Article 57 Where an administrative reconsideration authority, when reviewing the administrative act made by the respondent, considers that the basis thereof is illegal, if the authority has the power to handle the matter, it shall handle it according to law within thirty days; if it does not have the power to handle the matter, it shall transfer the matter within seven days to the state organ that has the power to handle it according to law.

Article 58 Where the administrative reconsideration authority, pursuant to the provisions of Articles 56 and 57 of this Law, has the power to handle the relevant regulatory document or basis, the administrative reconsideration body shall, within three days from the date of suspension of the administrative reconsideration, notify in writing the authority that formulated the regulatory document or basis to provide a written response on the legality of the relevant provisions. The formulating authority shall submit the written response and relevant materials within ten days from the date of receipt of the written notice.
If the administrative reconsideration body deems it necessary, it may request the authority that formulated the regulatory document or basis to explain the reasons in person, and the formulating authority shall cooperate.

Article 59 Where the administrative reconsideration authority, pursuant to the provisions of Articles 56 and 57 of this Law, has the power to handle the relevant regulatory document or basis, if it considers the relevant provisions to be lawful, it shall so inform in the administrative reconsideration decision; if it considers the relevant provisions to exceed the authority or violate superior laws, it shall decide to suspend the implementation of such provisions and order the formulating authority to rectify them.

Article 60 The administrative organ or state organ that accepts the transfer pursuant to the provisions of Articles 56 and 57 of this Law shall, within sixty days from the date of receipt of the transfer, reply with its handling opinion to the administrative reconsideration authority that made the transfer.

Article 61 When an administrative reconsideration authority hears an administrative reconsideration case in accordance with this Law, the administrative reconsideration institution shall review the administrative act and provide its opinions. After approval by the responsible person of the administrative reconsideration authority or adoption through collective discussion, an administrative reconsideration decision shall be made in the name of the administrative reconsideration authority.
For an administrative reconsideration case that has undergone a hearing, the administrative reconsideration authority shall make an administrative reconsideration decision in accordance with this Law based on the hearing record, the facts and evidence found and confirmed after review.
For an administrative reconsideration case where the opinion of the administrative reconsideration committee is sought, the administrative reconsideration authority shall treat the advisory opinion as an important reference basis for making the administrative reconsideration decision.

Article 62 For an administrative reconsideration case heard under ordinary procedure, the administrative reconsideration authority shall make an administrative reconsideration decision within sixty days from the date of accepting the application, unless the law prescribes a shorter time limit for administrative reconsideration. If the case is complicated and a decision cannot be made within the prescribed time limit, with the approval of the responsible person of the administrative reconsideration institution, the time limit may be appropriately extended, and the parties shall be notified in writing; however, the extension shall not exceed thirty days at most.
For an administrative reconsideration case heard under summary procedure, the administrative reconsideration authority shall make an administrative reconsideration decision within thirty days from the date of accepting the application.
Article 66 If the respondent fails to perform statutory duties, the administrative reconsideration organ shall decide that the respondent shall perform them within a certain period.

Article 67 Where an administrative act has major and obvious illegal circumstances such as the implementing entity lacking administrative entity qualifications or lacking a basis, and the applicant applies for confirmation that the administrative act is void, the administrative reconsideration organ shall confirm that the administrative act is void.

Article 68 Where the administrative act has clear facts, solid evidence, correct application of basis, lawful procedure, and appropriate content, the administrative reconsideration organ shall decide to uphold the administrative act.

Article 69 After the administrative reconsideration organ accepts an application for administrative reconsideration filed by an applicant who believes that the respondent has failed to perform statutory duties, if it finds that the respondent has no corresponding statutory duties or has already performed the statutory duties before acceptance, it shall decide to dismiss the applicant's administrative reconsideration request.

Article 70 If the respondent fails to submit a written reply, submit evidence, basis, and other relevant materials for the administrative act in accordance with Article 48 and Article 54 of this Law, it shall be deemed that the administrative act has no evidence or basis, and the administrative reconsideration organ shall decide to revoke or partially revoke the administrative act, confirm that the administrative act is illegal or void, or decide that the respondent shall perform within a certain period, except where the administrative act involves the lawful rights and interests of a third party and the third party provides evidence.

Article 71 Where the respondent fails to conclude, perform, or perform an administrative agreement in accordance with the agreement, or illegally modifies or rescinds an administrative agreement, the administrative reconsideration organ shall decide that the respondent shall bear the liability of concluding the agreement according to law, continuing performance, taking remedial measures, or compensating for losses.
Where the respondent lawfully modifies or rescinds an administrative agreement but fails to provide compensation according to law or provides unreasonable compensation, the administrative reconsideration organ shall decide that the respondent shall provide reasonable compensation according to law.

Article 72 Where an applicant concurrently submits an administrative compensation claim when applying for administrative reconsideration, if the administrative reconsideration organ finds that compensation shall not be granted in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, it shall, when making the administrative reconsideration decision, simultaneously decide to dismiss the administrative compensation claim; if compensation shall be granted in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, it shall, when deciding to revoke or partially revoke or modify the administrative act or confirm that the administrative act is illegal or void, simultaneously decide that the respondent shall grant compensation according to law; if it confirms that the administrative act is illegal, it may also simultaneously order the respondent to take remedial measures.
Where an applicant does not submit an administrative compensation claim when applying for administrative reconsideration, if the administrative reconsideration organ decides according to law to revoke or partially revoke or modify a fine, revoke or partially revoke illegal fundraising, confiscation of property, expropriation or requisition, apportionment of fees, or administrative acts such as sealing up, distraining, or freezing property, it shall simultaneously order the respondent to return the property, remove the measures of sealing up, distraining, or freezing property, or compensate corresponding amounts.

Article 73 Where the parties reach an agreement through mediation, the administrative reconsideration organ shall prepare an administrative reconsideration mediation agreement, which shall become legally effective upon being signed or sealed by the parties and affixed with the seal of the administrative reconsideration organ.
If the mediation fails to reach an agreement or either party retracts before the mediation agreement takes effect, the administrative reconsideration organ shall examine the case according to law or make an administrative reconsideration decision in a timely manner.

Article 74 Before an administrative reconsideration decision is made, the parties may voluntarily reach a settlement. The content of the settlement shall not harm national interests, public interests, or the lawful rights and interests of others, and shall not violate the mandatory provisions of laws or regulations.
After the parties reach a settlement, the applicant shall withdraw the application for administrative reconsideration from the administrative reconsideration organ. If the administrative reconsideration organ approves the withdrawal of the application for administrative reconsideration and the administrative reconsideration organ decides to terminate the administrative reconsideration, the applicant shall not file another application for administrative reconsideration on the same facts and grounds, except where the applicant can prove that the withdrawal of the application for administrative reconsideration was against its true intention.

Article 75 When making an administrative reconsideration decision, the administrative reconsideration organ shall prepare an administrative reconsideration decision document, which shall be affixed with the seal of the administrative reconsideration organ.
The administrative reconsideration decision document shall become legally effective upon service.

Article 76 During the handling of an administrative reconsideration case, if the administrative reconsideration organ discovers that an administrative act of the respondent or another lower-level administrative organ is illegal or inappropriate, it may issue an administrative reconsideration opinion letter to that organ. The relevant organ shall, within sixty days from the date of receipt of the administrative reconsideration opinion letter, report to the administrative reconsideration organ the situation of correcting the relevant illegal or inappropriate administrative act.

Article 77 The respondent shall perform the administrative reconsideration decision document, mediation agreement, and opinion letter.
If the respondent fails to perform or delays the performance of the administrative reconsideration decision document, mediation agreement, or opinion letter without justifiable reasons, the administrative reconsideration organ or the relevant higher-level administrative organ shall order it to perform within a time limit, and may interview the relevant responsible person of the respondent or circulate a notice of criticism.

Article 79 The administrative reconsideration organ shall, in accordance with the state's relevant provisions and based on the public disclosure status of the administrative act subject to administrative reconsideration, make the administrative reconsideration decision document available to the public.
Where a local people's government at or above the county level handles an administrative reconsideration case in which a working department of the said people's government is the respondent, it shall simultaneously send a copy of the legally effective administrative reconsideration decision document and opinion letter to the higher competent department of the respondent.

Article 80 Where an administrative reconsideration organ fails to perform its administrative reconsideration duties in accordance with the provisions of this Law, the responsible leaders and directly responsible personnel shall be given warnings, demerits, or serious demerits according to law; if it fails to correct after being urged by the organ with supervision authority or causes serious consequences, they shall be given demotion, dismissal, or expulsion according to law.

Article 81 Where personnel of the administrative reconsideration organ engage in favoritism or malpractice, or commit other acts of dereliction or malfeasance in administrative reconsideration activities, they shall be given warnings, demerits, or serious demerits according to law; if the circumstances are serious, they shall be given demotion, dismissal, or expulsion according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 82 Where a respondent, in violation of the provisions of this Law, fails to submit a written reply or to submit evidence, basis, and other relevant materials for the administrative act, or obstructs or indirectly obstructs citizens, legal persons, or other organizations from applying for administrative reconsideration according to law, the responsible leaders and directly responsible personnel shall be given warnings, demerits, or serious demerits according to law; if they engage in retaliation or frame-up, they shall be given demotion, dismissal, or expulsion according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 83 Where a respondent fails to perform or delays the performance of an administrative reconsideration decision document, mediation agreement, or opinion letter without justifiable reasons, the responsible leaders and directly responsible personnel shall be given warnings, demerits, or serious demerits according to law; if they still refuse to perform after being ordered to perform, they shall be given demotion, dismissal, or expulsion according to law.

Article 84 Where anyone refuses or obstructs administrative reconsideration personnel in investigating and collecting evidence, or intentionally disrupts the order of administrative reconsideration work, disciplinary sanctions or public security penalties shall be imposed according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 85 If an administrative agency or its staff violates the provisions of this Law, the administrative reconsideration agency may transfer the relevant facts of illegal conduct of the personnel to the supervisory agency or the agency or unit responsible for appointment and removal of public officials. The supervisory agency or the agency or unit responsible for appointment and removal of public officials that accepts the transfer shall handle the matter according to law.

Article 86 In the process of handling an administrative reconsideration case, if the administrative reconsideration agency discovers clues of issues concerning public officials suspected of embezzlement, bribery, dereliction of duty, or other duty-related violations or crimes, it shall transfer such clues to the supervisory agency in accordance with relevant provisions, and the supervisory agency shall investigate and handle the matter according to law.
Article 87 The administrative reconsideration agency shall not charge any fees to the applicant for accepting an application for administrative reconsideration.

Article 88 The calculation of the time periods for administrative reconsideration and the service of administrative reconsideration documents shall be executed in accordance with the provisions of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China on time periods and service, where this Law does not provide otherwise.
The provisions of this Law on the time periods for administrative reconsideration concerning "three days", "five days", "seven days", and "ten days" refer to working days, excluding statutory holidays.
Article 89 Foreigners, stateless persons, and foreign organizations applying for administrative reconsideration within the territory of the People's Republic of China shall have this Law apply.
Article 90 This Law shall come into force on January 1, 2024.
